items.text: Apotu kiswamaut inapen Iuecipitai ejok luka lobululu, ka lomuge, ka lokarenan, aijaanakinia kaibois nakalaunan, kiswamaut inapen lukalaunak kanuka Aaron; kwape ecorakinitor EJAKAIT Musa.

Kibenibenata esabu, kididiununutu adonyokinio lobululu, ka lomuge, ka Lokareŋan, ka ebaputa loejok, aswam naka ekeswaman loepiriana.
Apotu kiswamakis Iukokeperin, luimorikikinitai; kimorikikinitete kosaŋetake iarei.

Aenet naecipitai kapirianut, naaiai tomake aenia, arai naka aput adiopet, koputos kaswamuke; naka esabu, ka lobululu, ka lomuge, ka lokarenan, ka ebaputa Ioecipitai kiusio lueriim; kwape ecorakinitor EJAKAIT Musa.
Kigirut amor nuemelomeloto, kolukut kes kapesan nuka esa bu, kigirunai kaigiruneta nuka emacar, kwape ajaatar ikiroria luka idwe luka Isirael.
Kibwaik kes okeperin luka epod, araut amor nuka aisiitunet kanuka idwe luka Isirael; kwape ecorakinitor EJAKAIT Musa.
Abu kiswamau yenikatorob, aswam naka ekeswaman loepiriana, koputos kaswam naka cpod, yenika esabu ka lobululu, ka lomuge, ka lokarcnan, ka ebaputa loecipitai kiusio lueriim.
Korai yenika agoria aoŋon nueriakanara; kokudokis yenikatorob bala eriagi: aojauke atutubet naka ekubit, alalauke da atutubet naka ekubit.
Kipiripiranakis ikokoron iwonon luka amor: ekokoro losodit arai loka asadio, ka atopasit,
nu kere eraas amor nuegelegela nuka etiaŋ loepol.

Araas amor kwape ajaatar ikiroria luka idwe luka Isirael, atomon ka nuarei, kwape ajaatar ikiroriakec; kwape igiria emacar, ninituŋanan kwape ajaar ekekiror, kanuka atekerin atomon ka nuarei.
Apotu kiswamakis yenikatorob irikoi luesubito bala aunoi luka aswam naeojitoi naka esabu loelai.
Apotu kiswamaut apesan aarei nuka esabu, ka igilun iarei luka esabu; kibwaikis igilun nul iarei osaŋeta iarei luka yenikatorob.
Kibwaikis da irikoi nul iarei lueoiitoi luka esabu ogilun iarei kosaneta luka yenikatorob.
Kibwaikis isaneta luce iarei luka irikoi apesan aarei, kibwaikis kes okeperin luka epod, kowai lokoinaren.
Apotu kiswamaut igilun iarei luka esabu, kibwaikis osaŋeta iarei luka yenikatorob, toma atokitoitike naaiai owai lokotoma loka epod.
Kiswamaut igilun iarei luka esabu, kibwaikis kes okeperin iarei luka epod kwapuke, kowai lokoiŋaren, eiduny kaimorikikinetake, kuju aenet naka epod naecipitai kapirianut.
Koenikis igilun luka yenikatorob ka igilun luka epod keusi lobululu, tctere iboie kokuiu aenet naka epod naecipitai kapirianur, tetere mam yenikatorob ilajakin kepod; kwape ecorakinitor EJAKAIT Musa.
Abu kiswamau ekaso loka epod, korai kerc lobululu.
Ka apedot naka ekaso kotomake, kwape kapedot naka ekooti loka acuma, koiai atokitoit airimor apedotoke tetere mam ecila.
Kiswamakis atwelei nuka ekaso akamamagan nuka lobululu, ka lomuge ka lokarenan, ka cbaputa loecipitai kiusio lueriim.
Kiswamaut icirin luka esabu kaloelai, kibwaikis icirin kidin kakamamagan airimor atwelei nuka ekaso, kidin kakamamagan;
Ecirit ka akamamaga, ecirit ka akamamaga, airimor atwelei nuka eka so, aijaanakinia; kwape ecorakinitor EJAKAIT Musa.
Apotu kiswamaut ikootin luka ebaputa lociok, luka aswam naecipitai kanuka Aaron ka odweke.
Ka egoe lokieniena akou loka ebaputa loejok, ka igoen luejok luka akwes luka ebaputa Iociok, ka ipalei luka ebaputa loecipitai kiusio Iucriim.
Ka aenet naka aŋabet naka ebaputa loccipitai kiusio lueriim, ka lobululu ka lomuge, ka lokarenan, aswam naka ekasonyan; kwape ecorakinitor EJAKAIT Musa.
Apotu kiswamaut amekemeket naka aboko naka esabu kaloelai, kiwadikakisi akirot, kwape igiria emacar ebe, IKALAUNAN YENIKA EJAKAIT.
Koenikis eusi lobululu tomake, aenikinia ŋes kuju ogoe lokieniena akou; kwape ecorakinitor EJAKAIT Musa.
Kwaŋin kodaun aswam kere naka ewema lokalaunan loka ewema loka airiamunun: kiswamata idwe luka Isirael kwape ajaatar kere nuecorakinit EJAKAIT Musa, kiswamata kwaŋin.
Koyaut cwema lokalaunan mama ejai Musa, Ewema, ka iboroke kere, arucetake, ka abaoike, ka ariinoke, ka ipirinoke, ka aigaŋetake;
Ka eimukoret loka imukulen luka itakasin, ka egoe laka aigalisit;
Asaduku naka aiteienunct, ka adaketake, ka eicoloŋ-lokaitim;
Emesa, ka iboroke kere, ka imugatin luka aitodikin;
Epir loka atala loelai, ka atalaike, kes atalai nuesipokinio ejok, ka iboroke kere, ka akinyet naka atala;
Ka ctem loka esabu, ka akinyet nakinyonyoanakina ka lukisupurununo, ka aigalisit naka ekek loka Ewema;
Etem loka aisinit, ka eboike loka aisinit, ka adaketake, ka iboroke kere, akalaya ka aigaŋeteke;
Igoen luigalitoi luka alaro, ka ipirinoke, ka aigaŋetake, ka aigalisit naka erutc loka alaro, ka aunoike, ka iloinoke, ka iboro kere luka aijaanakin naka ewema lokalaunan, luka ewema loka airiamunun:
Inapen luecipitai ejok luka aiiaanakin kaibois nakalaunan, ka inapen lukalaunak kanuka Aaron esascdoti, ka inapen luka odweke, aijaanakinia kosasedotene.
Kwape ajaatar kere nuecorakinit EJAKAIT Musa, kiswamata idwe luka Isirael aswam kere.
Koany Musa aswam kere, ido koany, apotu kodaut aswam; kwape ecorakinitor EJAKAIT, kwape kwaŋin eswamatotor: kilipak Musa kes arereŋ.
